svg.title: Red-Violet Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Observed red-violet maps to the shared red family. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-new-paintings-05-1998/lightbox/works/red-violet-curve-1997-5072; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
